title: Add the delivery runner without starting a trace

costar.context: Schema writes do not post set. The delivery runner is the next remaining portal surface. A live delivery diagnose sends real SMTP, so this server must not start one.
costar.objective: Add the delivery trace form, the stage parser, and the stream URL, and do not open the live delivery stream.
costar.response: The form asks for a target and can start a trace. This page does not open /api/live/delivery.

concerns: GET /api/token/delivery is not an enterprise refusal. Opening /api/live/delivery starts a real SMTP diagnose.
A stage frame is event event with a JSON array. The type field is camelCase.
An empty token must not build a stream URL.
context: The page copies are Delivery Trace, Target address or domain, Start trace, and Enter a valid email address or domain. The stream path is /api/live/delivery/{target} with a token query. Frames use event: event. maxAttempts is 0. The phase names match the existing delivery graph.
current_state: Delivery Trace asks for a target, rejects an invalid one, and parses a stage frame. A valid Start trace does not open /api/live/delivery.
target_design: DeliveryRunner renders the form and any parsed stages. deliveryStreamUrl returns empty without a token. The route does not fetch the token or open EventSource. A valid click without a sender says the trace failed to start.
changes: Validate the target and build the stream URL.
Parse a delivery stage frame into phase labels.
Render the runner and keep the page from starting a trace.
boundaries: Do not open /api/live/delivery against this server.
Do not post a set or an action.

verification.name: delivery-does-not-start
verification.proves: A stage frame becomes MX Lookup, a bad target is rejected, an empty token builds no URL, and the page does not open the live stream.
verification.result: ok. Browser: invalid target shows the sentence, example.org shows Failed to start trace, and no request hit /api/live/delivery.

verification.name: ui-types
verification.proves: The runner and the delivery route typecheck.
